notes.title: Update #22 - New gamemode - new weapon - lots of changes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44425846/2dfcd343f61835cd1fe44c0f7d5f519be98c625c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44425846/a649a0578e40df309558bb7af610d5650e09bcd3.png
Big new update - This update includes a brand new gamemode I call "Eliminate the VIP", a new heavy LMG weapon, a internal stat/unlock overhaul and much more. 
Sorry for the delay, as some know I've moved into a new (my first!) house - so things have been a bit delayed!

Eliminate the VIP gamemode
Introducing a brand new gamemode I call "Eliminate the VIP" - Chase down and eliminate the VIP and you'll become it - now you must survive as everyone is out to get you! Earn points by staying alive as the VIP or by killing the VIP (and thus becoming it)
Consider it like a solo capture-the-flag or a king-of-the-hill type gamemode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44425846/555080dc854a84e8a690996d9a1c0aca4cbef68e.png

New weapon - LMG
I've made a new weapon - the LMG! It's a big and heavy rifle that has a very high fire rate and high ammo capacity. 
However, you gotta stand still for it to become accurate, if you move it'll shoot all over the place! 
Think of it like a turret!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44425846/7397acf72efc2243865e19e6b1ca3e838785f29c.png

Stat & unlocks overhauled - new UI
The stat and unlock system has been completely remade!
This means that you no longer have to wait for the end of the game to see your unlock progression, it'll happen instantly (same goes for Steam achievements!). Daily challenges now also reward exp - which they apparently never did before.. oops
I've also added a new UI notification that pops up on the screen whenever you unlock something.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44425846/a03143db45446902e88ed1e26d52deb446883181.png

Linux support
Monday Meltdown is now fully and natively supported on Linux! 
If any Steam Deck users wanna try it out - please let me know!

Misc
A bunch of other small things where also added - read the full changelog below!
I'm preparing up to release out of Early Access - so if you would like to wishlist the game (even if you own it), it will help build up the release! 
Thank you so much to you all reading & playing this!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44425846/1830f81206790f5e82792c2faca1efecfb9cc78a.png

Level tweaks
Latest update includes many new tweaks - some bigger some smaller.
For instance, I've redesigned the junkyard level to be more rectangular instead of squared. Seems like rectangular levels plays better due widescreen and the 2D perspective. (Hopefully, let me know)

Achivements
I've added 3 new achievements for you guys to unlock, I hope you enjoy them!
One of them contains a new secret player skin, let the search begin! Remember to bring your tools.

Other improvements
I've improved the scoreboard to better show more player information, including other player's ping and a few other small/minor tweaks.
The healthkit killstreak also now "overheals" the player - and a particle plays if overhealed

Audio overhaul
On the sound/music side, I've gotten help from the good Thomas Carnell (loktarg on discord), and he's given the whole game a music overhaul. This means all the sounds are now mixed better, normalized in volume and overall just more refined.
To go along with this, I've made a new sound play when you kill another player - this can however be disabled in the sound settings. 

Supporter edition DLC
Alongside this update - comes a new DLC who those who wants to support the game.
The DLC can be found here 
It's ofc fully optional and it contains only cosmetics like new player skins/taunts/weapons etc - thank you to anyone considering supporting me and the game.

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE - Rocket launchers, weapon knockback, health shader and much more!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44425846/a1523db658e0c57da2565c1148cc14bf8bc14cd0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44425846/2dfcd343f61835cd1fe44c0f7d5f519be98c625c.png

Latest update is a massive one - it included a new explosive RPG weapon (and a skin for you to unlock ofc!) and tons of features & fixes.

Player health shader!
I've added a new shader for the player which briefly shows how much health the player has left - shown when player is taking damage. Look at the damage-blink and you'll see a red bar fill up representing the health left.

Weapon knockback & core weapon change!
I've added the ability for weapons to have knockback and introduced this for the double-barreled shotgun, the rocket launcher and the sniper rifle.
Speaking of the sniper rifle, I've modified it to make it more viable. It can now be recharged and shot immediately after firing.
I've also now made it so that weapons don't destroy their projectiles upon weapon switching, so no more projectiles going "poof" when getting/switching to a new weapon.

Player dashing!
I've added an experimental player dashing mechanic by popular demand - It's disabled by default and can be enabled in the lobby settings. Let me know if it should be a part of the game always, I'm still on the fence about it!

LOTS of quality of life changes & balance tweaks
I've been fortunate enough to get the game tested by some new people (Chet Faliszek!) who streamed a 8-man game, playing himself for the first time. Some issues became apparent so I've took the time to really focus on a lot of small things and features - lots of quality of life features.
Kill notifications, up-scaling of some UI elements, new crosshair options & crosshair sizes, and general attempts at making stuff more clear!

For a full changelog - read below!

So, been a while since last update - I do apologize for that. However, that does not mean things haven't been cooking - introducing the biggest update yet!

New weapon!
There's a new weapon added to the arsenal, a P90! 
This gun has recoil that can be controlled, offering a satisfying way to spray down your enemies!

Weapon overhaul
Many of the old weapons now have gotten an overhaul! There's been voting going on on the Discord to which made the cut, so make sure to join it to cast your votes!
(join here - click me!)

Weapon attachments
Weapons now have attachments that can be unlocked! They vary from silly ones to serious ones, and some even have a hidden unlock requirement!
Flex your achievements by having some decked out guns!
I've also polished the weapon system by adding some slight weapon movement animations to the weapons.

New balance changes!
As part of the weapon overhaul, I've modified the grenade launcher and the revolver!
The grenade launcher can now be primed - hold in the fire button to shorten the detonation time. Time it correctly to avoid splattering yourself though!
The revolver now does not deal damage to the shooter - makes it surprisingly good!

Tons of internal changes & bugfixes
Improved the stat system by a lot - unfortunately that means I've had to reset your progress. This is hopefully the last time. However, now I can make unlocks much more exciting such as "get 5 kills without dying", "do xx while yy" and so on.
Every gamemode now waits a few seconds (with slow motion) when game is ending instead of the abrupt sudden gameover screen before.
I also optimized some of the system, including decreasing the used bandwidth per player.
Furthermore, a few bugs have fixed and possibly some new ones has appeared - let me know!

For a full changelog - read below!
